Najważniejsze różnice wynikają z konteks: The most important differences come from the context in which the apps are used, the content format and users' expectations. Instagram relies mainly on images, short video and fast scrolling. Facebook gives more room for description, education, comments and a calmer processing of the offer.

Szybkie przewijanie, pionowe formaty, li: Fast scrolling, vertical formats, lifestyle, reels, stories and a strong role for the first second.

Instagram częściej wygrywa szybkim obraz: Instagram more often wins with fast images and video, while Facebook more often helps fill in the context of the offer and close the user with arguments.

Facebook lepiej przyjmuje dłuższy opis,: Facebook is more receptive to longer descriptions, comparisons, social proof and offers that need explaining.

Jak wyglądają koszty i wyniki kampanii I: What do the costs and results of Instagram Ads vs Facebook Ads campaigns look like?
Koszty i wyniki zależą od branży, kreacj: Costs and results depend on the industry, the creative, the audience, the campaign objective and the quality of the landing page. Instagram can be more expensive per click, while at the same time generating very good visual engagement. Facebook often gives a more stable cost per click and better conditions for remarketing and offers that need a longer description.
Porównywanie platform wyłącznie przez CP: Comparing platforms solely by CPC or CPM leads to wrong conclusions. What matters is the cost per goal, the cost per conversion, ROAS and the real impact on sales. A higher CPM can be acceptable if the order value grows or the cost of acquiring a client falls at the same time.
Co porównywać zamiast samego CPC:: What to compare instead of CPC alone:
koszt leada lub sprzedaży,: the cost per lead or sale,
jakość ruchu po wejściu na stronę,: the quality of traffic after landing on the website,
udział kanału w ścieżce przed konwersją,: the channel's share in the path before conversion,
koszt celu według platformy i placementu: the cost per goal by platform and placement,
wpływ kreacji na formularze, koszyki i z: the creative's impact on forms, carts and inquiries.
Przy porównaniu wyników koniecznie anali: When comparing results, be sure to analyze data from the same period, with a similar campaign objective and similar audiences. Otherwise the comparison will be too random.
Czy lepiej prowadzić osobne kampanie na: Is it better to run separate campaigns for Instagram and Facebook, or one?
Wspólna kampania daje korzyść z pracy al: A shared campaign benefits from the algorithm's work and often lowers the cost per click, because Meta can flexibly shift the budget where it predicts a better result. Separate campaigns or ad sets, however, give more control over the budget, placements and the quality of reports.
Rozdzielenie warto rozważyć wtedy, gdy c: Splitting is worth considering when the objectives differ between channels, when personas behave differently or when you're testing creatives prepared specifically for IG and FB. Such a split improves the clarity of the data and makes shifting the budget easier.
